verdict.rationale: Base44 ships an official CLI that can create projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app. Its backend is defined in code and config files, and an SDK and sandbox connection allow scripted access. Together these make terminal-driven automation plausible, but the evidence never documents CI pipelines, non-interactive auth, or headless operation of the AI builder itself; the only auth shown is an interactive-looking `base44 login`. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), non-interactive or token-based CLI authentication, headless invocation of the AI build/edit agent, independent hands-on corroboration.
